The Grizzlies defeated the Raptors, 118-102 tonight in Toronto. Ty Jerome finished with a team-high 27 points along with 6 rebounds and 5 three pointers for the Grizzlies, while Cameron Boozer tallied 22 points, 8 assists and 7 rebounds in the game. Jamal Shead recorded 20 points, 11 assists and 4 three pointers. The Grizzlies improve their record to 7-3 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-5 for the season.
